en: The image is a black-and-white postcard showing a pavilion-like building with a distinctive conical roof and glass walls, surrounded by columns. There is an ornamental garden or landscaped area in front of the building, with a fountain or statue visible. The scene is set against a backdrop of dense forested hills, and a tree with broad leaves partially frames the view. Several people are seen walking along a path. The text 'Bad Elster. Salzquelle' appears on the bottom left.
